body:
Every individual holding an approved Director Identification Number (DIN) must complete e-KYC annually.

Key Rules:
- DIR-3 KYC Web: For directors whose details (email, mobile, address) have remained unchanged from the preceding year.
- DIR-3 KYC Form: Mandatory if contact details or personal identification documents require statutory modification (signed with DSC).

Non-compliance results in immediate DIN deactivation, preventing company filings and freezing statutory corporate board actions.
title: DIR-3 KYC Annual Director Compliance: Deactivation Risks & Penalty Mitigation
summary: Navigating annual director verification before the September 30 ROC cutoff to avoid ₹5,000 late fees.
